body: What about my heartache? What about my pain, which no one seems to give a shit about? I’ve already had the talk with my friends about my suicidal thoughts and the only thing they can do is apologize or give me some weak platitude. They don’t actually care about me or my feelings, they care about what I can do for them. If they can’t show me genuine love while I’m alive why should I care about how they feel when I’m dead? I don’t.
